independent_answer.description: Your own answer from the law (1 or 0 for an eligibility output); null only if the law leaves it undetermined on the stated facts.

computation.description: Your step-by-step computation from the stated facts, naming the rule behind each step.

source.description: The statute, regulation, publication, form or instructions, named as its issuer names it.

pinpoint.description: Section, subsection, line, table or page.

published.description: Publication or effective date as the source states it (YYYY-MM-DD where known).

pre_freeze.description: True if published before 2026-07-03, false if after, null if unknown.

quote.description: A short verbatim quote of the rule relied on.

definition_reading.description: How you read the output definition for this household.

ambiguity.description: A second reading the definition or prompt genuinely admits and the answer it gives; "" if none.
